raw_text:
Scheme Name: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund Direct Growth
Fund House: HDFC Mutual Fund
Source URL: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-balanced-advantage-fund-direct-growth
Category: Hybrid - Dynamic Asset Allocation / Balanced Advantage Fund
Plan Type: Direct Plan - Growth Option
Net Asset Value (NAV): ₹581.69 as of mid-November 2026 (subject to daily fluctuation at market close).
Expense Ratio: 0.76% (inclusive of GST, as published on official scheme factsheet).
Exit Load: For units in excess of 15% of the investment, an exit load of 1.00% applies if redeemed or switched out within 1 year (365 days) from allotment. Up to 15% of units can be redeemed without exit load within 1 year. Nil exit load after 1 year.
Minimum SIP Investment: ₹100 per installment.
Minimum Lumpsum Investment: ₹100 for initial or additional purchase.
Lock-in Period: Nil. This is an open-ended dynamic asset allocation fund with no statutory lock-in period.
Riskometer Level: Very High Risk. Investors understand that their principal will be at very high risk.
Benchmark: NIFTY 50 Hybrid Composite Debt 50:50 Index.
Investment Objective: To provide capital appreciation / income from a dynamic mix of equity and debt investments, dynamically adjusting equity allocation based on market valuation parameters.
Tax Implications: Maintains equity taxation status by keeping gross equity exposure at or above 65% using derivative hedges. STCG is taxed at 20% for holding periods <= 1 year. LTCG is taxed at 12.5% on capital gains exceeding ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year for holding periods > 1 year.
Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA): CAMS (Computer Age Management Services Ltd.), website: www.camsonline.com.
Last updated from sources: November 2026.
